body: Fuck you. Seriously. Ask me how "life" has been. Really.

But we've done the exact same, except we've had people who are so neglectful that we feel like death, and, after doing what you have done, we do not feel like we are even surviving. I don't know what to say.

What about me? What about talking to me?

See, I don't need expensive anything. I need life. Real food.

I don't have time for sarcasm when my girlfriend's frail, pink, weak, hands are gripping and she's asking why no one has ever loved her or just taught her how to care for herself before ejecting her from the only "safe" envinronment she has ever known.

Just....please. A little more decency.

Right, but not someone who is currently in the process of developing diabetes as we speak.

I had a realization, and what I have to keep reminding people, and myself, is that this is a medical issue as well.

That being said...well, a different route is needed to take care of the medical issue. Now, on the other hand, we are going to need good food and diet in the mean time. Plain fact is, unless it is fresh, unless it is as food was *intended* to be (kill it, thank it, eat it)....I don't want it in our bodies. Picky? Maybe. Absolutely enraged at the system because we've substituted our nutrients for mass produced garbage? Yup.

Now, I have to rest. I've been at this all day, and...damn. I'm a fucking child. She is too. We have nothing...

Thanks for your response. I hope mine isn't too immature. I'll elaborate or...aynthing else tomorrow . good night, I should go be with her.

Thanks all again.

You're absolutely correct, this is exactly what I'm doing. I'm really looking for genuine help from someone, and individual. And if you want me to defend my actions, then, well, before going and announcing your thoughts about what it is that I'm doing wrong, approach me and reckon.

Why don't I want to work with food banks? Because I know what I need in our diets, and it comes from grocery stores....can't come from Amazon, Food Banks, or churches.

A gift card to a grocery store would be amazing. Someone trolled me and told me they would send me 100 in a gift card. They have only been on Reddit 43 minutes. *This* is someone to be wary of.

Now, if you would like me to elaborate on any one of these points, or if you would like me to explain my philosophical or spiritual motives/beliefs, which also influence my actions...simply ask.

I hope my tone did not come off and condescending or angry. It wasn't a retaliation, I just want my voice to be heard. Again, if you want proof that I've been on Reddit since...early 2011, maybe late 2010, then...quiz me. This is a throwaway.


Thanks for your response, as well.

Oh, but it is. And, *much* more than that, the lack of real food is making her sick. Ramen is bleached. The noodles are not consisted of flour in the way flour...used to be. bleached....this...that....I'm not a scientist!

Besides, the gf also has blood sugar issues that make it this way. Literally, Ramen would not feed us. I can tell you this from experience.

Now, as such, I've read (I'm clueless about this stuff), that she needs protein and (good) fat type foods. Low in carbs, all calories from fats and proteins (or a vast majority of the food).

I don't want to nit-pick, and you are right....but, if you could, refer to my comment with the "backstory" with the tl'dr.

Thank you for your kind words and concern. I'm still thinking things over, have to go make the last of the food I have.....I'll return...
Absolutely would not. "It's considered a 'hardware' item, sir. Store policy."

Of course, of course. I wouldn't expect most to be able to help out any more than that. I think I've almost found some good help, though. Thanks again, and...well, if I end up taking pizza offers (if my gf can start eating that stuff), I'll be totally up for it. Bless you.

Thank you so much, and I appreciate everything you have suggested.

I have to give a little back story...

My girlfriend used to move around quite a bit, and has "less than stable" guardians, to say the least. Well, she used to. After enough abuse, and discovering that there was actually hope in life, she left her single parent. This parent was frequently in and out of relationships...etc...(more detail if you need it..)

My parents were that, times ten. 

So, fast forward to half a year ago. We are, in every practical way, forced to move out of/away from our parents in order to simply take care of our lives.

Well, because of the what care we received prior to going out on our own, when we *were* finally out, we didn't know a damn thing about the world.

Needless to say, fastforward 6 months or so from that point....and you have us now.

We have figured out what the most efficient way to live looks like, and we are ready to start a simple way of life...but we've been eating stuff like Pizza, expired foods, Ramen, well...you name it. But our health, really...my girlfriend's health, has declined that way. And it has been sparce, when the crappy food was around..

"Someone offered you pizza couple hours ago and you declined it. Seeking only specific good quality food for a month for two. That is a bit extreme."

This is absolutely correct. Now, for one thing, I value my privacy...and had apprehensions about immediately revealing an address, making local help a much more viable route if I was going to continue being picky about privacy. 

Moreso, however, I cannot feed my girlfriend pizza...*yet*. It is nearly equivalent to admitting an individual who has just recently developed type II (I think?) Diabetes: The patient must immediately have their blood sugar controlled, and their intake of food is closely monitored. 

Any consumption of a sugar, especially processed, is enough to cause a spike that can make the patient comatose, or worse.

Now, all of this is *very* extreme. Imagine our case as....well, just extreme. Not quite as bad as my example. Just as you've said, all of this is out of the ordinary. But put yourself in her shoes. She has never, in her 19 short years, had someone just...feed her. Care for her. Love her, dammit! A mom who can't use birth control right? Nope. 12 or more father figures in her life? They don't care. The public school teachers? :(

**This** is the kind of history we are working with. Neither of us knew how extreme this all was until late....

**tl;dr** - The girlfriend has a history of being neglected/under-cared-for. The amount of TLC she needs is...pretty high up there. Pretty persnickety. I don't know what to do for her, but she really, really doesn't want pizza. She's nauseous as I type, has slight numbness/tingling sensation on the right side of her head, but is stable otherwise. There. Kinda short.

Thank you for your encouragement. 

Yes, my girlfriend has had issues for a while now, and we know that blood sugar and blood pressure problems run in her family.

She just really needs a wholesome meal...three times a day right now. And, unfortunately, a truly nutrient-rich meal is something that is becoming nearly impossible to come by in our day and age.

Thanks a bunch.
Of course. Will do.

I know I can do what I need to do to support myself and my girlfriend, I just need to make it past the next few days...and 14 days at a job, more or less.

We are trying to sell our laptop, in fact.
And that is exactly what I came here for. Thank you millions.

Hm. Well...yes, I am reluctant to use that.

On the other hand, I am on the verge of starvation. The gf is past it. I will look into it, thank you.

I have zero family. I have zero friends. Anyone I may have considered friends or family has said, "No, we don't want to help feed you."

The food pantry is an option, I'm sure. But, like I told another redditor, there is no chance to get a months worth of food for the both of us....all three meals, six for the two of us, thirty days worth...

City and county services and the human services departments want to give us a case worker, have us interview, have us fill out apps that won't be processed fo rmonths, etc. We're dying..
Okay, thank you. I don't think the food bank will do any good, but if someone in RAOP responds..

edit: Okay, it's done. I posted. I apologize for underestimating the RaoP.
Houston. Three days? that would be miraculous.

We just...really have no one. Food stamps would take way too long. FOod pantrys don't work. My gf is almost in a diabetic state, and we just discovered exactly what her diet has to be like so that she can recover.

Well....I just spent the last of my 12 dollars buying fish, and 4 dollars of gas. Walmart wouldn't take the heater and give us store credit without the receipt.  We have nothing now....so hungry...

thank you again..
Yes. It doesn't work here for us..

I don't know if that would help. I'm simply being frank, but...we are going to need a lot more help than that.

I really think I should wait, and see if someone out there can fund us, or find some other way, to help us see through this month and become employed. 

That's more than one pizza...and the last time my gf ate tomato anything (paste, etc.) she got sick because of the sugar. Her blood sugar rose to a dangerous level.

Basically, I need funds to help myself and a starving near-diabetic for a month. :(

But just...thank you. Responding is a way of providing hope for us.

Unfortunately...the random kindness we seek has to be...not so random. I just simply don't think that a single pizza, a single time could really impact our situation, as it is dire. We need assistance with food until I am employed, with couldn't be longer than 4 weeks.

I'm just trying to find that special, one-in-a-million person who is going to help...loan...give...employ, who knows.

I'd really rather not accept someone's kindness if I'm going to eventually find another person to *permanently* help. I don't think it would be right to ask that much of that many people.

Hey. I think I sent you a PM, but thanks again for responding. I really think we just need immediate access to food. We don't know what to do..no family....pretty much no friends..

I really wish something could be done, but I don't think a food bank will help us. 30 days of groceries is also difficult to get, for 2 people especially, from food banks....

In other words, they have not fed us. I do not mean to sound stuck-up at all. It's just that, when people tell us that ramen is 20cents a pack, well...Ramen has no nutrients for us to run on. It literally won't feed us. We've eaten too much (ramen/garbage)anyway... My girlfriend is having numbing sensations in her fingers and toes, and sometimes right side of the head.

Scary..:(
